title: File:L'Arrivée du Grand Raid 2011.jpg
claims: The file shows a runner arriving at the 2011 Grand Raid finish chute, with spectators and a sponsor backdrop.
The file description says the runner was third overall and the first Réunion finisher of the Grand Raid.
The uploader and author is Henijai, credited as own work.
The file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 (Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0).
The file description names the result but does not give a venue.
